name: cartel-vendas-whatsapp-bot
description: Middleware que conecta o WhatsApp da Cartel (via Chatwoot/BranorAI) a Claude para atendimento/qualificacao automatica de vendas.

scripts.test: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=test-key CHATWOOT_BASE_URL=http://localhost CHATWOOT_ACCOUNT_ID=1 CHATWOOT_API_TOKEN=test-token WEBHOOK_SECRET=test-secret DATA_DIR=.test-data MESSAGE_DEBOUNCE_MS=50 tsx --test $(find src -name '*.test.ts' | sort)
